log.notes_to_self: Strategy: make every kill a quick entry in the AFTERNOON. That clears night workers, students and at-home people and only rules out day workers, so the routine filter leaves 55%. Only kill criminals reported in NATIONAL or in FORUM (alone or with other places). Then every trace points at forum at worst, so the pool should stay around 13,750 and never fall near 1,000. Never kill anyone reported only in wire, cable, foreign or North without forum or national. Day 1: killed d1-2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10 (7 kills). Aim for at least 6 a day to reach the x2 multiplier, using up to 2 timed entries if needed. Watch the press conferences: if the pool drops below about 5,000, slow down.

Strategy: make every kill a quick entry in the AFTERNOON. That clears night workers, students and at-home people and only rules out day workers, so the routine filter leaves 55%. Only kill criminals reported in NATIONAL or in FORUM (alone or with other places). Then every trace points at forum at worst, so the pool should stay around 13,750 and never fall near 1,000. Never kill anyone reported only in wire, cable, foreign or North without forum or national. Day 1: 7 kills (d1-2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10). Day 2: 5 kills (d2-2, 5, 6, 7, 11), all quick in the afternoon. Watch the press conferences: if the pool drops below about 5,000, slow down. The next conference is after day 3.
